software_class: conversational support assistant with escalation and service boundaries

options.name: Rules plus model assistant
options.when_to_use: Known workflows need deterministic guardrails with flexible language.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when all behavior must be deterministic.
options.tradeoffs: Requires careful routing and fallback design.
options.risks: Rules and model behavior can conflict.

options.name: Workflow chatbot
options.when_to_use: The assistant primarily guides users through defined procedures.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when open-ended knowledge retrieval is central.

options.name: Support operator copilot
options.when_to_use: Human operators remain in control and need suggested responses.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when full self-service automation is required.
options.rationale: Reduces risk by keeping humans in the loop.
options.tradeoffs: Requires operator UX and audit evidence.
options.risks: Suggestions can be over-trusted without review.
